audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 4-5 and first item read Skill, and 2+ items read Fiora while whys[6] and spikes[3] say the late game is where you reclaim it in 5v5.
audit.why: The mirror flipped win[3]/phases[3] and win[5]/phases[5] to Fiora and win[6]/phases[6] to K'Sante; the packet agrees, and a 46.79% win rate with a 10/10 carry threat is not a lane K'Sante controls at 4-5.
audit.corrected: Levels 4-5 and first item to Fiora at 3/10, 2+ items to K'Sante at 6/10, in both layers, with all three phase whys rewritten.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns, and the first-item row claimed the Iceborn timing as a fight window while spikes[2] on the same page says her item spike shreds your armour.
audit.why: Riposte is 24s at rank 1 falling to 16s — long enough that a baited parry is a real window — and Lunge drops from 13s to 6s, which is why her spacing improves so sharply through the mid levels.
audit.corrected: 24s and 13s written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and wants.you[0]; phases[5].why now says what her item actually does.

audit.whatIsWrong: MISSING INTERACTION: the page never said Riposte's stun is conditional. It also carried 'Q3 knockup' in mid, wants.you[0] and wants.foe[0], which the mirror flagged but could not fit into band from its side.
audit.why: Riot's text: the stab slows the first champion hit, or STUNS them if Fiora blocked an immobilizing effect with it. Your Path Maker stun and your two-stack Ntofo pull are both immobilizing, so leading with either is what arms the stun that kills you — while a parried Q or auto only leaves a slow. Ntofo Strikes also shockwaves at two stacks and pulls, not knocks up.
audit.corrected: The conditional stun written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[1].d, wants.foe[0] and phases[3].why; the pull replaces the knockup in mid, wants.you[0], wants.foe[0] and tradeGood.

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[0].d was filler under the heading 'Stand still for vitals'.
audit.why: Duelist's Dance restores health and grants Move Speed on a Vital hit — the reason spacing off the marks is worth more than any single stat.
audit.corrected: Stated in dontsFull[0].d; report[8].t already carries anti-heal.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Riposte's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Your lane-control window is neutered: every W charge and pull is bait for Riposte, which stuns because both immobilize.

edits.before: Iceborn Gauntlet is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Riposte's cooldown.
edits.after: Her first item and stacked Vitals shred your armour faster than one tank piece holds.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Fiora carry threat 10/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on: your armour finally matters in 5v5 — R-recall her off a carry and her splitpush stops mattering to the game.

edits.before: - Fiora Riposte: matchup-defining — Parries your combo + stuns. Bait it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Riposte: 24s at rank 1 down to 16s — it only stuns if it blocks an immobilize, so your W stun and your pull both arm it. - Lunge: 13s early, and it applies on-hit. - Your R: kill windows only.

edits.before: Parries your combo + stuns. Bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Riposte is 24s, and it stuns only if it parries an immobilize — bait it.

edits.after: Chain Q slows on Fiora, two stacks to pull her in once Riposte is spent, W through Bladework, then peel out or All Out.

edits.before: That is Fiora's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Hitting a Vital heals her and speeds her up — keep moving off the marks.

edits.after: A parried immobilize comes back as a stun — that is her whole trade.

edits.after: Riposte your W stun or your pull — both immobilize, so her parry stuns back, then Vital you down

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are normally my lane-control peak, but Fiora's parry breaks the pattern — every W charge and Q3 knockup is bait for her riposte stun, and a parried W is a death sentence. Trade in short bursts: poke Q, threaten the W-pull to make her hold parry, then back off before her Vitals stack. At 6 my All Out gives a real 1v1, but it sheds my tankiness exactly when she ignores armor with percent-HP true damage, so only flip it when her W and Q dash are both down.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are normally my lane-control peak, but Fiora's parry breaks the pattern — every W charge and two-stack pull is bait for her riposte stun, and a parried W is a death sentence. Trade in short bursts: poke Q, threaten the pull to make her hold parry, then back off before her Vitals stack. At 6 my All Out gives a real 1v1, but it sheds my tankiness exactly when she ignores armor with percent-HP true damage, so only flip it when her W and Q dash are both down.

notes: The decisive mechanic was absent from the whole page: Riposte only stuns if it parries an IMMOBILIZING effect. Both of K'Sante's engage tools immobilize, so the sequencing rule is to spend a throwaway Q into the parry (slow only) and keep the W stun and the pull for after it. Also cleared the 'Q3 knockup' language the mirror could not fit from its side. Left untouched and UNVERIFIED: the repeated claim that Vitals deal percent-max-health true damage — Riot's text for Duelist's Dance mentions only heal and Move Speed, and the true-damage tag sits on Grand Challenge, so I did not strengthen or delete those lines.
